```{r setup}
params <- list(
  seed = 12435,
  workers = 4,
  interactive = TRUE,
  prior_count = 2,
  low_q_threshold = 0.25,
  high_q_threshold = 0.74,
  gene_fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  pathway_fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  rds_dir = "../results/rds_slc6a8_continuous_ErythCorrection/",
  table_dir = "../results/tables_slc6a8_continuous_ErythCorrection/",
  data_dir = "../data/",
  fig_dir = "../results/figures_slc6a8_continuous_ErythCorrection/",
  msigdb_dir = "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"
)

# Load packages ----------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(yaml)
  library(DT)
  library(writexl)
  library(yulab.utils)
  library(edgeR)
  library(limma)
  library(unikn)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(forcats)
  library(scales)
  library(factoextra)
  library(ggridges)
  library(car)
  library(reshape2)
  library(matrixStats)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(clusterProfiler)
})

# Load functions ---------------------------------------------------------------
source("../../scripts/functions.R", local = TRUE)
source("../../scripts/GSEA_camera.R")
source("../../scripts/makeFitObject.R")

# Load globals -----------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(params$seed)

if(!dir.exists(params$rds_dir)) dir.create(params$rds_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(params$fig_dir)) dir.create(params$fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(params$table_dir)) dir.create(params$table_dir, recursive = TRUE)

de_table_cols <- c(
  "GENEID", "Symbol", "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

round_de_table_cols <- c(
  "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

shiny_path <- file.path(
  params$rds_dir, "shiny", "rds"
)

msigdb_dir <- "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"
```

# Load data

```{r load-data}
dat <- as.data.frame(fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "beataml_waves1to4_counts_dbgap.txt")))
dat_norm <- as.data.frame(fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "beataml_waves1to4_norm_exp_dbgap.txt")))
meta_clinic <- fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "beataml_wv1to4_clinical.csv"))
meta_sample <- fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "beataml_waves1to4_sample_mapping.csv"))
cnts <- as.matrix(dat[, grep("BA", colnames(dat))])
cnts_norm <- as.matrix(dat_norm[, grep("BA", colnames(dat_norm))])
meta_clinic <- meta_clinic[meta_clinic$dbgap_rnaseq_sample %in% colnames(cnts) &
                             meta_clinic$dxAtInclusion == "ACUTE MYELOID LEUKAEMIA (AML) AND RELATED PRECURSOR NEOPLASMS", ]
cnts_aml <- cnts[, colnames(cnts) %in% meta_clinic$dbgap_rnaseq_sample ]
cnts_norm_aml <- cnts_norm[, colnames(cnts_norm) %in% meta_clinic$dbgap_rnaseq_sample ]
meta_clinic <- meta_clinic[match(colnames(cnts_aml), meta_clinic$dbgap_rnaseq_sample), ]

grp <- data.frame(
  OriginalSampleName = colnames(cnts_aml),
  Condition = rep("AML", ncol(cnts_aml)),
  sex = "NA",
  CellLine = "NA",
  SampleGroup =  c(rep("AML", ncol(cnts_aml)) )
)
grp$Condition <- factor(grp$Condition, levels = c("AML"))
grp$SampleGroup <- factor(grp$SampleGroup, levels = c("AML"))

gnes <- data.frame(
  Symbol = dat$display_label,
  GENEID = dat$stable_id,
  DESCRIPTION = dat$description,
  SYMBOL = dat$display_label
)
rownames(gnes) <- gnes$GENEID

dge <-  DGEList(counts = cnts_aml,
                norm_counts = cnts_norm_aml,
                samples =grp,
                genes = gnes)
rownames(dge$genes) <- dge$genes$GENEID
rownames(dge) <- dge$genes$GENEID

gnes_norm <- data.frame(
  Symbol = dat_norm$display_label,
  GENEID = dat_norm$stable_id,
  DESCRIPTION = dat_norm$description,
  SYMBOL = dat_norm$display_label
)
rownames(gnes_norm) <- gnes_norm$GENEID

dge_norm <-  list(counts = cnts_norm_aml,
                samples = grp,
                genes = gnes_norm)
rownames(dge_norm$genes) <- dge_norm$genes$GENEID
rownames(dge_norm$counts) <- rownames(dge_norm$genes)
rownames(dge_norm$samples) <- dge_norm$samples$OriginalSampleName

gene_sets <- readRDS(file.path(params$msigdb_dir, "msigdb_v2025.1.Hs_gene_sets.rds"))
```

# Blast counts

```{r}
blast_p <- as.data.frame(cbind(as.numeric(meta_clinic$`%.Blasts.in.BM`), as.numeric(meta_clinic$`%.Blasts.in.PB`)))
colnames(blast_p) <- c("% Blasts BM", "% Blasts PB")
rownames(blast_p) <- meta_clinic$dbgap_rnaseq_sample

ggplot(blast_p, aes(x = "", y=.data[["% Blasts BM"]]))  +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter( width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 0.4)  +
  theme_bw() +
ggplot(blast_p, aes(x=.data[["% Blasts BM"]]))  +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_bw() +
ggplot(blast_p, aes(x = "", y=.data[["% Blasts PB"]]))  +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter( width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 0.4)  +
  theme_bw() +
ggplot(blast_p, aes(x=.data[["% Blasts PB"]]))  +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_bw() +
ggplot(blast_p, aes(x = .data[["% Blasts BM"]], y = .data[["% Blasts PB"]])) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle(paste0("cor=", round(cor(blast_p[,1], blast_p[,2] , use = "complete.obs"), 2)))
```

```{r results='asis'}
perc_blasts = 80
```

```{r}
blast_p <- cbind(blast_p[,c(1,2)],
                 "% Blasts BM.PB" = blast_p[,1])
blast_p[,3][is.na(blast_p[,3]) & !is.na(blast_p[,2])] <- blast_p[,2][is.na(blast_p[,3]) & !is.na(blast_p[,2])]
blast_p$include <- ifelse(blast_p[,3]>perc_blasts & !is.na(blast_p[,3]), TRUE, FALSE)

ggplot(blast_p, aes(x = "", y=.data[["% Blasts BM.PB"]]))  +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = include), width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 0.5)  +
  theme_bw() +
ggplot(blast_p, aes(x=.data[["% Blasts BM.PB"]]))  +
  geom_histogram(aes(color=include)) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
dge <- dge[, blast_p$include == TRUE]
dge_norm$samples <- dge_norm$samples[blast_p$include == TRUE,]
dge_norm$counts <- dge_norm$counts[,blast_p$include == TRUE]
```

# Extract SLC6A8 expression

```{r}
dge <- dge[-which(rownames(dge) == "ENSG00000268982"), ]
gnes <- gnes[-which(gnes$GENEID == "ENSG00000268982"), ]
```

```{r}
gene_col = "GENEID"
gene = c( "ENSG00000130821")

slc6a8_expr <- list()

ridx <- which(dge_norm$genes[, gene_col] %in% gene)
slc6a8_expr$norm <- dge_norm$counts[ridx, ]
ylab <- paste0("Harmonized counts (CQN)")

slc6a8_expr$raw <- dge$counts[ridx, ]
ridx <- which(dge$genes[, gene_col] %in% gene)
slc6a8_expr$norm_cpm  <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = params$prior_count)[ridx, ]
```

# Check potential cofounders

```{r}
covariate_names <- c("FLT3-ITD", "NPM1", "RUNX1", "ASXL1", "TP53", "ELN2017", "cohort", "consensus_sex", "ageAtSpecimenAcquisition", "dbgap_rnaseq_sample", "isDenovo", "isRelapse", "specimenType")
```

```{r}
covariate <- meta_clinic  %>% select(all_of(covariate_names))
```

```{r}
covariate$`FLT3-ITD`[covariate$`FLT3-ITD`  == ""] <- NA
covariate$NPM1[covariate$NPM1  == ""] <- NA
covariate$RUNX1 <- ifelse(covariate$RUNX1 == "", "negative", "positive")
covariate$ASXL1 <- ifelse(covariate$ASXL1 == "", "negative", "positive")
covariate$TP53 <- ifelse(covariate$TP53 == "", "negative", "positive")
covariate$ELN2017 <- gsub("NonInitial|MissingKaryo", NA, covariate$ELN2017)
covariate$ELN2017 <-  factor(covariate$ELN2017, levels = c("Adverse", "IntermediateOrAdverse", "Intermediate", "FavorableOrIntermediate", "Favorable"))
covariate$cohort <- gsub("\\+", ".", covariate$cohort)

covariate$perc_blasts <- blast_p$`% Blasts BM.PB`

covariate$isDenovo[covariate$isDenovo == "unknown"] <- NA
covariate$isRelapse[covariate$isRelapse == "unknown"] <- NA
covariate$disease_stage <- with(covariate, case_when(
  isDenovo  == "TRUE"  ~ "denovo",
  isRelapse == "TRUE"  ~ "relapse",
  TRUE                 ~ "other_secondary"
))
covariate$disease_stage <- factor(covariate$disease_stage,
                                  levels = c("denovo", "relapse", "other_secondary"))
covariate$isDenovo <- NULL
covariate$isRelapse <- NULL
covariate$specimenType[covariate$specimenType == "Leukapheresis"] <- "Peripheral Blood"

covariate <- covariate %>%
  dplyr::rename("FLT3_ITD" = "FLT3-ITD")
covariate <- covariate[match(names(slc6a8_expr$raw), covariate$dbgap_rnaseq_sample)]
covariate$lib.size <- dge$samples$lib.size
```

```{r}
ASSAY <- "norm"

covariate$slc6a8 <- slc6a8_expr[[ASSAY]][covariate$dbgap_rnaseq_sample]

na_summary <- sort(colMeans(is.na(covariate)) * 100, decreasing = TRUE)
cat("Percentage NA values:")
print(round(na_summary[na_summary > 0], 1))

cont_vars <- c("ageAtSpecimenAcquisition", "perc_blasts", "lib.size")
names(cont_vars) <- c("Age", "% blasts", "Library size")

cor_results <- sapply(cont_vars, function(v) {
  x <- covariate[[v]]
  cor.test(covariate$slc6a8, x, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")$estimate
})
names(cor_results) <- gsub("\\.rho", "", names(cor_results))

cor_p <- sapply(cont_vars, function(v) {
  x <- covariate[[v]]
  cor.test(covariate$slc6a8, x, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")$p.value
})

cat("Continuous covariates; spearman correlation with SLC6A8:\n")
print(round(sort(abs(cor_results), decreasing = TRUE), 3))

cat("Continuous covariates; pvalue of spearman correlation with SLC6A8:\n")
print(round(sort(abs(cor_p), decreasing = TRUE), 3))

cat_vars <- c("ELN2017", "FLT3_ITD", "NPM1", "RUNX1", "ASXL1", "TP53",
              "cohort", "consensus_sex", "specimenType", "disease_stage")
names(cat_vars) <- c("ELN2017 risk", "FLT3-ITD", "NPM1", "RUNX1", "ASXL1", "TP53",
                     "Cohort wave", "Sex", "Specimen type", "Disease stage")

kw_results <- sapply(cat_vars, function(v) {
  grp <- covariate[[v]]
  if (length(unique(na.omit(grp))) < 2) return(NA)
  kruskal.test(covariate$slc6a8 ~ grp)$p.value
})
cat("Categorical covariates; Kruskal-Wallis pvalue:\n")
print(sort(kw_results))
```

# Filtering

```{r}
stopifnot(all(colnames(dge) == covariate$dbgap_rnaseq_sample))

dge$samples$slc6a8_raw  <- slc6a8_expr$raw[colnames(dge)]
dge$samples$slc6a8_norm <- slc6a8_expr$norm[colnames(dge)]
dge$samples$slc6a8_norm_logcpm <- slc6a8_expr$norm_cpm[colnames(dge)]

dge$samples$FLT3_ITD    <- factor(covariate$FLT3_ITD)
dge$samples$NPM1        <- factor(covariate$NPM1)
dge$samples$RUNX1       <- factor(covariate$RUNX1)
dge$samples$ASXL1       <- factor(covariate$ASXL1)
dge$samples$TP53        <- factor(covariate$TP53)
dge$samples$ELN2017     <- factor(covariate$ELN2017)
dge$samples$cohort      <- factor(covariate$cohort)
dge$samples$specimenType  <- factor(covariate$specimenType)
dge$samples$disease_stage <- factor(covariate$disease_stage)
dge$samples$sex         <- factor(covariate$consensus_sex)
dge$samples$perc_blasts <- covariate$perc_blasts
dge$samples$age         <- covariate$ageAtSpecimenAcquisition
dge$samples$lib.size    <- covariate$lib.size

dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")

keep <- filterByExpr(dge,  min.count = 10, min.total.count = 15)
keep[which(!names(keep) %in% rownames(dge_norm$counts))] <- FALSE
dge_filt <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
cat(sprintf("Genes retained: %d / %d\n", sum(keep), length(keep)))
```

```{r}
na_mask <- complete.cases(dge_filt$samples[, c(
  "slc6a8_norm", "FLT3_ITD", "NPM1", "RUNX1", "ASXL1", "TP53",
  "cohort", "perc_blasts", "specimenType", "lib.size"
)])
cat(sprintf("Samples dropped due to NA: %d\n", sum(!na_mask)))

dge_red <- dge_filt[, na_mask, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_red_norm <- dge_norm
dge_red_norm$counts <- dge_red_norm$counts[match(rownames(dge_red), rownames(dge_red_norm$counts)),
                                          match(colnames(dge_red), colnames(dge_red_norm$counts))]
dge_red_norm$samples <- dge_red_norm$samples[match(colnames(dge_red), rownames(dge_red_norm$samples)), ]
dge_red_norm$genes <- dge_red_norm$genes[match(rownames(dge_red), rownames(dge_red_norm$genes)), ]

s <- dge_red$samples
```

# Adding erythroid proportions

```{r}
bm_prop <- fread("../results/tables_slc6a8_continuous/CIBERSORTx_BM.csv") %>% as.data.frame()
pb_prop <- fread("../results/tables_slc6a8_continuous/CIBERSORTx_PB.csv") %>% as.data.frame()

bm_eryth_cols <- grep("eryth", colnames(bm_prop), value = TRUE)
pb_eryth_cols <- grep("eryth", colnames(pb_prop), value = TRUE)

bm_prop$eryth_sum <- rowSums(bm_prop[, bm_eryth_cols, drop = FALSE])
pb_prop$eryth_sum <- rowSums(pb_prop[, pb_eryth_cols, drop = FALSE])

dge_red$samples <- dge_red$samples |>
  dplyr::left_join(bm_prop[, c("Mixture", "eryth_sum")],
                   by = c("OriginalSampleName" = "Mixture")) |>
  dplyr::rename(bm_eryth = eryth_sum) |>
  dplyr::left_join(pb_prop[, c("Mixture", "eryth_sum")],
                   by = c("OriginalSampleName" = "Mixture")) |>
  dplyr::rename(pb_eryth = eryth_sum)

dge_red$samples$eryth_prop <- ifelse(
  dge_red$samples$specimenType == "Bone Marrow Aspirate",
  dge_red$samples$bm_eryth,
  dge_red$samples$pb_eryth
)
```

# QC

```{r}
slc6a8_pal <- colorRampPalette(c("#4E79A7", "#F0F0F0", "#E15759"))(100)
cohort_cols <- setNames(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(levels(dge_red$samples$cohort)), "Set2"),
  levels(dge_red$samples$cohort)
)

logcpm <- cpm(dge_red, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

s        <- dge_red$samples
rownames(s) <- dge_red$samples$OriginalSampleName
slc6a8_r <- slc6a8_expr$raw[rownames(s)]
slc6a8_n <- slc6a8_expr$norm[rownames(s)]
```

## PCA {.tabset}

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8, results='asis'}
top_var  <- order(rowVars(logcpm), decreasing = TRUE)[1:2000]
pca      <- prcomp(t(logcpm[top_var, ]), scale. = FALSE, center = TRUE)
pct_var  <- round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:4], 1)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1     = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2     = pca$x[, 2],
  PC3     = pca$x[, 3],
  sample  = rownames(s),
  cohort  = s$cohort,
  slc6a8  = slc6a8_n,
  FLT3_ITD = s$FLT3_ITD,
  NPM1    = s$NPM1,
  RUNX1   = s$RUNX1,
  ASXL1   = s$ASXL1,
  TP53    = s$TP53,
  perc_blasts = s$perc_blasts,
  specimenType = s$specimenType,
  disease_stage = s$disease_stage,
  eryth_prop = dge_red$samples$eryth_prop
)

for (VAR in colnames(pca_df[, -c(1:4)])){

  cat("###", VAR, "\n\n")

  p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = .data[[VAR]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      colour = VAR,
       x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[2])
    )
  if (VAR %in% c("slc6a8", "perc_blasts", "eryth_prop")) {
    p_pca <- p_pca + scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#4E79A7",
      mid = "grey",
      high = "#E15759",
      midpoint = median(pca_df[[VAR]], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  } else {
    p_pca <- p_pca + scale_colour_discrete(na.translate = FALSE)
  }

  p_pca2 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, colour = .data[[VAR]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      colour = VAR,
       x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[3])
    )
  if (VAR %in% c("slc6a8", "perc_blasts", "eryth_prop")) {
    p_pca2 <- p_pca2 + scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#4E79A7",
      mid = "grey",
      high = "#E15759",
      midpoint = median(pca_df[[VAR]], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  } else {
    p_pca2 <- p_pca2 + scale_colour_discrete(na.translate = FALSE)
  }

  print(p_pca + p_pca2)

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Pairwise correlation

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
set.seed(42)
idx_cor  <- sample(nrow(logcpm), min(3000, nrow(logcpm)))
cor_mat  <- cor(logcpm[idx_cor, ], method = "spearman")

ann_col <- data.frame(
  SLC6A8  = slc6a8_n,
  Cohort  = s$cohort,
  FLT3    = s$FLT3_ITD,
  NPM1    = s$NPM1,
  row.names = colnames(cor_mat)
)

slc6a8_breaks <- seq(min(slc6a8_n, na.rm = TRUE),
                     max(slc6a8_n, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)

ann_colors <- list(
  SLC6A8 = slc6a8_pal,
  Cohort = cohort_cols,
  FLT3   = c(positive = "#E15759", negative = "#A0CBE8"),
  NPM1   = c(positive = "#F28E2B", negative = "#D3D1C7")
)

pheatmap(
  cor_mat,
  color             = colorRampPalette(c("#4E79A7", "white", "#E15759"))(100),
  breaks            = seq(0.7, 1.0, length.out = 101),
  annotation_col    = ann_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  show_rownames     = FALSE,
  show_colnames     = FALSE,
  treeheight_row    = 30,
  treeheight_col    = 30,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  border_color      = NA,
  fontsize          = 9,
  main              = "Sample-to-sample Spearman correlation (top 3000 variable genes)"
)
```

# Differential Expression

## Design matrix

```{r results='asis'}
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ slc6a8_norm  + FLT3_ITD + NPM1 + RUNX1 + ASXL1 + TP53 +
    cohort + specimenType  + eryth_prop,
  data = dge_red$samples
)

cat("Design matrix dimensions:", dim(design), "\n")
cat("Coefficient of interest: 'slc6a8_norm_logcpm'\n")
cat("All coefficients:\n"); print(colnames(design))
```

## QC

### Voom plot

```{r}
v <- voom(dge_red, design, plot = TRUE)
```

## Mean-variance trend after eBayes

```{r}
fit  <- lmFit(v, design)
fit  <- eBayes(fit, trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)

plotSA(fit, main = "Mean-variance trend after eBayes")
```

## Results summary

```{r}
iqr_slc6a8_norm <- IQR(dge_red$samples$slc6a8_norm)

lfc_thr_raw <- 1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm
```

```{r}
fdr_thr  <- 0.05
lfc_thr  <- lfc_thr_raw

res <- topTable(
  fit,
  coef      = "slc6a8_norm",
  number     = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by    = "P"
)

res$SYMBOL <- ifelse(is.na(res$SYMBOL) | res$SYMBOL == "",
                     rownames(res), res$SYMBOL)
res$neg_log10_p <- -log10(res$P.Value)
res$neg_log10_fdr <- -log10(res$adj.P.Val)

res$direction <- case_when(
  res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thr & res$logFC >  0 ~ "up",
  res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thr & res$logFC < 0 ~ "down",
  TRUE                                             ~ "ns"
)
res$direction <- factor(res$direction, levels = c("up", "down", "ns"))

diffexp_gene_table <-   res |>
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) |>
    mutate(Direction = case_when(
      logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
      TRUE ~ "Down"
    )) |>
    summarise(N = n(), .by = Direction) |>
    mutate(Contrast = "SLC6A8") |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Contrast, names_from = Direction, values_from = N)

kable(diffexp_gene_table)
```

## Log-fold change interpretation

```{r}
iqr_slc6a8 <- IQR(dge_red$samples$slc6a8_norm)

res$logFC_per_IQR <- res$logFC * iqr_slc6a8
res$raw_logFC = res$logFC
res$logFC = res$logFC_per_IQR
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
iqr_slc6a8_norm   <- IQR(dge_red$samples$slc6a8_norm)
lfc_thr_raw       <- 1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm

res$direction <- case_when(
  res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thr & res$logFC_per_IQR >  1 ~ "up",
  res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thr & res$logFC_per_IQR < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                                              ~ "ns"
)
res$direction <- factor(res$direction, levels = c("up", "down", "ns"))

plot_df <- data.frame(
  logFC         = res$raw_logFC,
  logFC_per_IQR = res$logFC_per_IQR,
  direction     = res$direction,
  SYMBOL        = res$SYMBOL,
  adj.P.Val     = res$adj.P.Val
)

genes_highlight <- c("SLC6A8")
top_lab <- bind_rows(
  plot_df |> filter(direction == "up")   |> slice_max(logFC_per_IQR, n = 1),
  plot_df |> filter(direction == "down")  |> slice_min(logFC_per_IQR, n = 1),
  plot_df |> filter(SYMBOL %in% genes_highlight)
) |> distinct()

dir_cols <- c(up = "#E15759", down = "#4E79A7", ns = "grey80")

p_main <- ggplot(plot_df,
                 aes(x = logFC, y = logFC_per_IQR, colour = direction)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = top_lab, size = 3.1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data         = top_lab,
    aes(label    = SYMBOL),
    size         = 3.8,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    segment.size = 0.3,
    colour       = "black"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
             linetype   = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2) / iqr_slc6a8_norm,
             linetype   = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1),
             linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.5, colour = "grey20") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm, y = max(plot_df$logFC_per_IQR) * 0.3,
           label = sprintf("raw logFC = %.3f\n→ IQR logFC = 1 (2-fold)",
                           1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm),
           hjust = -0.05, size = 4.8, colour = "#E15759") +
  annotate("text",
           x = -1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm, y = min(plot_df$logFC_per_IQR) * 0.3,
           label = sprintf("raw logFC = %.3f\n→ IQR logFC = −1 (½-fold)",
                           -1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm),
           hjust = 1.05, size = 4.8, colour = "#4E79A7") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dir_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title    = "Raw logFC vs. IQR-scaled logFC",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "y = x × IQR  |  IQR of SLC6A8 (CQN log2) = %.2f log2 units  |  slope = %.2f",
      iqr_slc6a8_norm, iqr_slc6a8_norm),
    x = "Raw logFC \n(per 1 log2 unit increase in SLC6A8)",
    y = sprintf("logFC per IQR \n(per %.2f log2 unit increase in SLC6A8)",
                iqr_slc6a8_norm)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_raw_dens <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = logFC, fill = direction)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 0, 1) / iqr_slc6a8_norm,
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of raw logFC",
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = raw equivalents of IQR logFC −1, 0, +1",
       x = "Raw logFC", y = "Gene count") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_iqr_dens <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = logFC_per_IQR, fill = direction)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, colour = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = c(-2, -1, 1, 2),
           y = Inf, vjust = 2, size = 4.6,
           label = c("4-fold\nlower", "2-fold\nlower",
                     "2-fold\nhigher", "4-fold\nhigher")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of IQR-scaled logFC",
       subtitle = "Dashed lines at interpretable fold-change",
       x = sprintf("logFC per IQR (%.2f log2 units)", iqr_slc6a8_norm),
       y = "Gene count") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

(p_main) /
(p_raw_dens + p_iqr_dens) +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "Relationship between raw and IQR-scaled logFC",
    caption = sprintf(
      "IQR = %.2f log2 units | raw logFC threshold = %.3f | n = %d genes | Significant (FDR < 0.05, |logFC/IQR| > 1): %d",
      iqr_slc6a8_norm, lfc_thr_raw, nrow(plot_df), sum(plot_df$direction != "ns")
    )
  )
```

# Pathway enrichment analysis

```{r}
ranked_list <- res$t
names(ranked_list) <- res$GENEID
ranked_list <- sort(ranked_list, decreasing = TRUE)

ranked_list <- ranked_list[!is.na(ranked_list)]
ranked_list <- ranked_list[!duplicated(names(ranked_list))]

ranked_list <- ranked_list[-which(names(ranked_list) == gene)]

collections_keep <- c(
  "H",
  "C2:CGP",
  "C2:CP:KEGG_LEGACY",
  "C2:CP:REACTOME",
  "C2:CP:WIKIPATHWAYS",
  "C5:GO:BP",
  "C7:IMMUNESIGDB"
)

gene_sets_filt <- gene_sets[gene_sets$collection_name %in% collections_keep, ]

term2gene <- gene_sets_filt |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tidyr::unnest(cols = ensembl) |>
  dplyr::select(
    gs_name = geneset_name,
    ensembl_gene = ensembl
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene %in% names(ranked_list)) |>
  as.data.frame()

term2name <- gene_sets_filt |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  dplyr::select(
    gs_name           = geneset_name,
    description_brief
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  as.data.frame()

gsea_res_txt <- file.path( params$table_dir, "gsea_all.txt"  )
if(!file.exists(gsea_res_txt)){

  set.seed(42)

  gsea_res <- GSEA(
    geneList     = ranked_list,
    TERM2GENE    = term2gene,
    TERM2NAME    = term2name,
    eps          = 0,
    minGSSize    = 15,
    maxGSSize    = 500,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    verbose      = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(gsea_res, file = file.path(params$rds_dir, "gsea_output.rds"))

  gsea_res <- gsea_res %>% as.data.frame()

  gsea_res$collection_name <- gene_sets_filt$collection_name[match(gsea_res$ID, gene_sets_filt$geneset_name)]
  gsea_res$Ngenes <- lengths(strsplit(gsea_res$core_enrichment, "/", fixed = TRUE))
  gsea_res$fractionOverlap <- gsea_res$Ngenes/ gsea_res$setSize
  core_enrichment <- data.frame("ID" = gsea_res$ID,
                                "core_enrichment" =  gsea_res$core_enrichment)
  gsea_res$core_enrichment <- NULL
  gsea_res$leading_edge <- NULL

  write.table(
    gsea_res,
    file.path(
      params$table_dir,
      "gsea_all.txt"
    ),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
  )

  write_xlsx(
    gsea_res,
    file.path(
      params$table_dir,
      "gsea_all.xlsx"
    )
  )

  write_xlsx(
    gsea_res |>
      dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05),
    file.path(
      params$table_dir,
      "gsea_sig.xlsx"
    )
  )

  write.table(
    core_enrichment,
    file.path(
      params$table_dir,
      "gsea_core_enrichment.txt"
    ),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
  )

} else {

  gsea_res <- fread(gsea_res_txt) %>% as.data.frame()
  rownames(gsea_res) <- gsea_res$ID

  core_enrichment <- fread(file.path(
      params$table_dir,
      "gsea_core_enrichment.txt"
    )) %>% as.data.frame()

}
```
